title: Was Penrose Right? NEW EVIDENCE For Quantum Effects In The Brain
summary: PBS Space Time examines Roger Penrose's idea that consciousness arises from quantum processes in the brain, and reviews new evidence about microtubules. It ends with an estimate of what replicating consciousness would demand.
why: Pointed to as a clear, balanced overview of quantum-brain theories when AI consciousness and brain models come up.

quote.text: check especially the ending summary where they calculate more or less how much would be necessary
